entities.summary: The Elton John AIDS Foundation (EJAF) is a nonprofit organization established by the British musician Elton John in 1992 in the United States and 1993 in the United Kingdom to support innovative HIV prevention, education programs, direct care and support services to people living with or at risk of HIV. It has raised over $565 million to support HIV-related programs across ninety countries.
